text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen, held around Christmas 
time... This year, it was taking on a 
slightly different look.

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
It's started! The "Arima Kinen" Public 
Post-Position Draw~!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
"Until now, the post positions for the 
Arima Kinen have been decided by
automatic 
lottery draws via computer and the like."

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
"However, this year, Umamusume teams 
selected by lottery will be allowed to 
choose their preferred gate positions! 
This is a first in the history of the 
Arima Kinen!"

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
"Here are the two guest presenters for
the 
lottery draw! First up, making huge waves 
on the dirt tracks again this year: Hokko 
Tarumae!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
All the way from Tomakomai! I hope to 
become a second home for your heart♪ I'm 
Hokko Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...All right, perfect!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
And the other one is this runner! A 
legendary Umamusume holding numerous 
records, including multiple victories in 
the Arima Kinen! It's Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm Oguri Cap. Nice to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Umm... today, we're drawing the lottery 
and then eating, right?

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text: That's not it!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder what criteria they were
chosen 
on?

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
Who knows...? She's cute, so isn't that 
fine?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the first-ever public draw for the 
Arima Kinen, the participating Umamusume 
were all visibly restless. Yet,
naturally, 
Gentildonna remained—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"This drink... It's delightfully fruity 
and delicious."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Quite an aromatic fragrance. Hmm...
choice_data_list: This carrot juice looks like wine...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Why don't you have a sip to refresh your 
spirits?"
choice_data_list: The carrot juice looks just like w...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: She seems nervous, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After receiving the invitation to the 
public barrier draw...
when I brought up a 
consultation regarding our priority 
preferences for post positions—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: What is your wish?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Nakayama Racecourse, the first corner 
comes right after the start. Inner gates, 
and even-numbered gates that load into
the gate later, are predicted to have the 
advantage.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Let's go with that, then.
choice_data_list: Huh? What about the other prioriti...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "No need. Because—"
choice_data_list: Huh? What about the other prioriti...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—There shouldn't be any problem. As long 
as my name is called first, that's all 
that matters.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"If we do that, we can choose our 
preferred gate. Luck is part of skill... 
Let's give it a try."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna uncharacteristically talked 
about going with the flow. Her intent was 
likely... pure confidence,
no matter which 
gate she drew.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I offer a prayer. Gentildonna's power is 
the real deal. That is precisely why I 
want to prove she has fortune on her side 
too... that she holds everything in her 
hands.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Giggle.

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
Without further ado, let's begin the 
lottery! —Oguri, if you would please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A clear bowl is placed before her. Inside 
are balls containing the names of the 
competing Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I just have to grab any ball I like, 
right? ...All right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap eagerly plunged her hand into 
the bowl of balls! And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—Gentildonna. You get to pick your gate 
first.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Even divine luck bends to my will.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer, hurry up and fan me. 
Before the Goddess of Victory slips away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The murmurs didn't reach my ears—when my 
eyes met Gentildonna's, she gave me... a 
gentle smile."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen.
Nothing less than victory 
will do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After all post positions had been drawn, 
and some time after the party had begun—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I believe it is about time we took our 
leave.
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll call a car.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Ah, as for where we're going... I'll let 
you decide.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you for your kind words.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It is Christmas,
after all. You'll show me 
something entertaining, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "Hmm... It's quite lively here."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We arrived at Furlong Tower, a popular 
spot among young people. Special 
illuminations are displayed here on 
Christmas.
choice_data_list: I just thought it wasn't a place w...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes.
choice_data_list: I just thought it wasn't a place y...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Huh... Lady Gentildonna?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: W-Why are you here?!
choice_data_list: Looks like some of your fans are h...
Looks like some of your fans are h...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: So it seems.
choice_data_list: Looks like some of your fans came ...
Looks like some of your fans came ...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Gentildonna is here! No way~, gotta 
post this on Umastagram!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you're right! Me too, me too...!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: W-Waaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, out of nowhere—the fans 
surrounded Gentildonna, forming a wall to 
protect her from the surroundings!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
It's Christmas...! I won't let anyone get 
in Lady Gentile's way...!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
"We'll form a wall to hold them back!
Lady 
Gentile, please, make your move now!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho... What a fascinating arch.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps I shall let myself be protected 
for once. Thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~~! So... radiantly cute...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by fans, Gentildonna seemed 
somewhat amused.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh my...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Gentildonna looks around the area with 
curious eyes.
The place she was brought to 
was an amusement park decked out in 
Christmas decorations."
choice_data_list: This place is famous for its light...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "So it seems. Shining brilliantly..."
choice_data_list: This place is famous for its illum...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Look at that, what a huge wreath!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Don't you think this would be just 
perfect if we combined it with squats?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely where my splendid
charm 
lies."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Pardon me. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: So... what else is there here?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Could you tell me what moves your heart 
the most?
choice_data_list: The best one... I'm looking at it ...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Now?
choice_data_list: My number one... I'm looking right...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Indeed, your number one.
